description: Set catchup=False on all new production DAGs
when_to_use: All new production DAGs by default
anti_pattern: catchup=True on a new DAG (floods scheduler with historical runs)
fix: Set catchup=False; run explicit backfill DAG separately

description: Prevent concurrent runs on same partition
anti_pattern: max_active_runs > 1 (risks race condition on same partition)

description: Use fixed datetime not dynamic now()
Group related tasks for visual clarity
anti_pattern: Flat list of 20+ tasks without grouping

description: XCom is for small metadata not dataframes
when_to_use: Passing job IDs partition keys row counts
anti_pattern: Passing entire DataFrames through XCom (stored in DB)
fix: Write to intermediate storage; pass path via XCom

description: Alert on SLA breach for critical DAGs
when_to_use: Gold layer and serving layer DAGs

description: Task produces same output for same inputs
anti_pattern: Task appends data on every retry (duplicates on failure)
fix: Use partition overwrite or upsert semantics

description: Incremental watermark respects slowest upstream source
when_to_use: Downstream tables fed by multiple independent jobs
anti_pattern: Global max(timestamp) watermark skips late rows from slow sources forever
fix: Per-source watermarks (take min); or lag buffer max(ts)-interval; or gate on all upstream completions

description: Offset same-interval jobs so they never fire together
when_to_use: Many jobs sharing */15 or hourly schedules
anti_pattern: All jobs fire at :00/:15/:30/:45 and stampede the warehouse
fix: Derive minute offset from stable hash of dag_id modulo the interval

description: DAG imports only from dags/ tree and installed packages
anti_pattern: Importing from scripts/ or notebooks/ that are not in the deployed image
fix: Inline the logic in the DAG file or package it into the image

description: LLM/HTTP tasks retry transient failures and defer leftovers
when_to_use: Any task calling an external API
anti_pattern: One provider timeout fails the whole DAG run
fix: Per-request timeout + bounded backoff inside task; task retries>=2; unprocessed rows picked up next run

description: YAML files must be tab-free (parser rejects tabs as indentation)
anti_pattern: Tab characters pasted into YAML cause ScannerError at load
fix: Check with grep -P '\t' file.yml; configure editor to spaces; validate yaml.safe_load in CI

description: Debug from the first error in the full task/driver log
anti_pattern: Reacting to the last surfaced line (often a benign warning or generic pod failure)
fix: Fetch complete log from storage; find first ERROR/traceback; for Spark read the driver pod section

description: Warehouse/GPU-heavy jobs run one at a time via pools
anti_pattern: Concurrent heavy jobs assumed not to collide because schedules differ
fix: Assign an Airflow pool with 1 slot to the heavy resource
